*F-obf* (Obfuscation, split VBB, iO) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: open — no accepted UC formulation exists yet.

*References:*

- Barak et al. *On the (im)possibility of obfuscating programs*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2001, 2001.
- Canetti, Goldwasser, and Poburinnaya. *Adaptively secure two-party computation from indistinguishability obfuscation*. In 12th Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part II, pages 557–585, 2015.
